Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 0  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to differentiate between the University of Mississippi (Ole Miss) and its School of Law when determining the first black student admitted, leading to an incorrect identification of James Meredith instead of Cleve McDowell. This oversight caused the wrong answer by not specifying the correct educational institution within Ole Miss.
